depiction.primary_object: side profile of speaking mouth and nose with sound arc
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: profile silhouette on left, curved wave on right, crossed by diagonal line

ambiguity: At small sizes, the cropped nose-and-chin line is broken by the slash and looks like an abstract squiggle, the numeral 5, or a broken ear icon.

reasoning: The icon depicts a speaking face profile with a sound wave crossed out by a diagonal slash (representing voiceover off, disabled speech output, or silence/vocal rest). Because the slash breaks up the already minimal contour of the nose and lips, it is difficult to recognize at list size and only applies to niche tasks like disabling screen-reader speech, stripping narration, or resting one's voice.
